crossRefs.note: Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, And the fire has devoured the pastures…
Ahab said to Obadiah, “Go through the land, to all the springs of water, and to all the brooks. Perhaps we may find…
How long will the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell…
Yes, the doe in the field also calves and forsakes her young, because there is no grass.
The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights. They pant for air like jackals. Their eyes fail, because there is no…
Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the…
For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

translations.web: How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
translations.bsb: How the cattle groan! The herds wander in confusion because they have no pasture. Even the flocks of sheep are suffering.
translations.kjv: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
translations.asv: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
